kiel-holstein-switzerland-plon-malente-e.story: Green lakes, rolling bends and proper northern touring rhythm. The best part sits around Preetz old-road gate, Plön castle lake, Eutin lake road, while Bad Malente coffee stop keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.

scenicChapters.title: Preetz old-road gate → Plön castle lake
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 34 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
